_note: World-news RSS/Atom feeds. Only headline + snippet + link are used; articles are never copied. weight lifts the most trusted newsrooms slightly in ranking.
_criteria: Straight-news reporting from an established newsroom with public editorial standards and a corrections policy.
Prefer public-service broadcasters and papers of record; avoid outlets whose news coverage is driven by a strong partisan or ideological line, far left or far right.
No state-controlled outlets, tabloids, press-release feeds (e.g. an organisation's own news site) or aggregators.
Keep a spread of countries so the edition isn't one country's view of the world, and keep the political lean of the list balanced overall.

Last reviewed 2026-11-08. Removed: Al Jazeera (state-funded, contested on Gulf/Middle East coverage), South China Morning Post (ownership and editorial-independence concerns), UN News (an organisation's own news site), MercoPress (small, single-issue slant), Times of India (sensational tendencies), Washington Post (trimmed to avoid stacking US centre-left papers), ABC Australia (no working world feed). AP, Reuters and the Telegraph would be good choices but block feed readers; CBC passes curl but stalls for Node fetch (worth retrying later).
